passages.context: The official Latin Fifth Commandment response was inspected at the first, superscript-n-marked paragraph 2267 after 2266 and before 2268. Its note identifies that wording as the new version and links the rescript. A later, explicitly labelled Versione precedente preserves the superseded text; this passage controls only the first, revised paragraph 2267.
passages.notes: This passage belongs to the dated amended Latin web state, not the fixed 1997 typical-edition baseline. The restricted HTML was not retained, so no central transcription or replayable physical-line locator is claimed.
